app.name: Senti
app.tagline: The world map of finds, along the routes of history's great commanders.

categorie.sottotitolo: Pick the right icon: it drives how it looks on the map.

cattura.sottotitolo: Pick the icon, then add a photo or a couple of lines. Location comes from GPS or a tap on the map.
cattura.registro: Everything you publish is recorded under your name, even when you choose anonymity: others see an anonymous name, the ledger knows it's you. Today the ledger is about recognition. If the platform ever earns revenue, the ledger is the basis for sharing it. We don't promise figures: we promise the count is transparent and no one can erase it.

vuoto.generico: There's a campaign out there waiting for your first find.

intro.comeFunziona: Senti is a map of finds along the routes of history's great commanders. The routes are already traced: you enrich them with what you find or know — war relics, but also minerals, fossils, treasure.
intro.anonimo: You can choose to stay anonymous: others won't see your name, but the system will. It's used to recognize your contributions and track them in the ledger.
intro.regola: What you publish is your responsibility. To publish someone else's content or a source you must have permission.
intro.prova: Senti is a trial and is built with the help of artificial intelligence: it may contain errors or behave unexpectedly. Use it accordingly.

patto.testo: Before you start, take a look at the Terms of use and the Privacy notice. Terms are accepted once; the Privacy notice explains how we handle your data.
patto.accetto: I accept the Terms and have read the Privacy notice

cookie.testo: We use technical cookies, necessary to operate and always on. Only if you want, we also use statistics cookies to understand how the app is used. You can change your mind anytime in settings.

cookie.tecnici: Technical cookies are always on: they make the app work and can't be disabled.
